title: Melting Mirror Portal
description: A large ornate golden picture frame leans against the wall on a checkered floor, its bottom edge melting and dripping yellow liquid. Through the frame, a surreal colorful geometric structure emits rainbow light beams and yellow clouds, while the surrounding room shows dark blue curtains, stormy skies, and scattered figures in the background.
prompt: A large golden picture frame is tilted and melting at the bottom, dripping yellow liquid onto a green and white checkered floor. Inside the frame appears a surreal colorful geometric portal with rainbow beams of light and yellow clouds spilling out. The room has dramatic blue curtains, stormy skies visible through an opening, scattered figures in the background, and a black silhouette of a shoe near the melting frame, in a detailed surreal painting style.
